If you love restaurant-style prawns, you have to try these Butter Garlic Prawns! Perfectly crispy prawns tossed in a rich, creamy butter garlic sauce. It's one of my favourite appetisers, and I've shared the exact recipe along with all my tips to help you get the same restaurant-style results at home.
My favourite way to enjoy these is with some hot butter naan, and trust me, the combination is absolutely incredible! Do give it a try.
The full written recipe is in the description below.
Happy Cooking!
